declaration.argument: Only work whose answer is already known is dropped. The plan engine keeps exact counts of Ready and not-Completed events, so its per-step scan runs only when an event is ready, releasing the same events in the same order, is_complete reads the count, and a record's delivery-name lookup runs only while a deliver event is ready, when it can match. Text known to be UTF-8 by construction (trace buffers built from whole strings, decimal digits) is not checked again, and a struct literal's fields are placed without first filling unit placeholders. No draw, value, row, container order or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs), Mencius (2,160 runs), a crash-heavy session (1,800 runs) and a caps-engaged VR session of 100,000 runs: all four tables identical both ways, log, trace and execution text byte-identical, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons, steps and cap figures, runs_failed 0; scans plus skipped scans equal steps exactly and planned_events_outstanding_sum is unchanged.
